description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the quote request is complete for the published fee model; no fee figures are returned.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

quote.description: The quote request: seller_price_micro, facilitator, scheme, and the facilitator's position inputs where its fee model needs them (e.g. cdp_monthly_tx_position for CDP past the free tier).
